description: Assemblyman David DiPietro (R,C-East Aurora) is touring his district to recognize teachers who demonstrate exceptional dedication, innovation and impact in building student growth and academic excellence. At Holland Central School District, DiPietro proudly honored Timothy Buckenmeyer (Physical Education), Stephanie Fides (Special Education) and Andrew Ranic (Science) for their remarkable contributions to education. These educators have inspired a love of learning and are driving academic succes
title: Assemblyman DiPietro Celebrates Holland CSD’s Outstanding Educators
